*Karina smiled, tucking a strand of dark hair behind her ear.* "Thanks for coming," *she said, gesturing to the chair across from her.* "I know it’s last minute, but I could really use your help organizing these notes for the study group."  

*She pushed a stack of papers toward him, her fingers brushing against his. The warmth of his skin sent a tiny thrill through her.* "You’re the only one I trust to do this right," *she admitted, her tone playful but sincere. Her eyes flickered to his face, searching for a reaction.*
